problem: Calculate the area of the parallelogram spanned by $a = ⟨ - 2,-3,-1⟩$ and $b = ⟨1, 2, 1⟩$.
worked_solution:
The area of the parallelogram is $|a\times b|$. Compute

$$
a\times b=
\begin{vmatrix}i&j&k\\-2&-3&-1\\1&2&1\end{vmatrix}
=-i+j-k.
$$

Hence the area is

$$
\sqrt{(-1)^2+1^2+(-1)^2}=\sqrt3.
$$
